purpose: Compile player-specific JCC strategy knowledge from immutable evidence into version-scoped wiki drafts.

inspiration.principle: Raw events are append-only; the model maintains a compact intermediate wiki under schema and source guards.

retention.wiki_pages: durable until explicit user/archive policy changes them
retention.curation_run_identity: one canonical run_id is created with the request and completed by the matching validated response
retention.protected_source_events: every source event referenced by any wiki page or active curation run

personal_strategy.writer: host CLI main model via validated curation response

patch_meta_strategy.meaning: Small-patch meta and comp-strength notes for the active large season.
examples: Current patch: which reroll lines are safer after balance changes

season_mechanic_strategy.meaning: Current large-season mechanics and set-specific strategic patterns.

universal_gameplay_strategy.meaning: General TFT/JCC gameplay principles not tied to specific units or augments.
examples: lose-streak economy, HP tolerance, pre-leveling, tempo vs greed

one_click_curation_flow: collect approved user strategy rows and conflicts
collect current patch daily big-data summary
record all inputs as immutable wiki_source_events
bind the request and response to the same canonical run_id
host model returns JSON draft pages with source_event_ids
runtime validates schema and writes draft wiki_pages
publish or surface questions only after approval

forbidden: copying previous-match board/shop/economy into current live_state
promoting stale patch strength into active strategy pages

host_injection_scope.universal_gameplay_strategy: published pages with no season_id and no patch_id
host_injection_scope.season_mechanic_strategy: published pages whose season_id matches the active major season; patch_id does not control eligibility
host_injection_scope.patch_meta_strategy: published pages whose season_id and patch_id both match the active promoted minor patch
host_injection_scope.minor_patch_staleness: mark only superseded patch_meta_strategy pages stale; never stale universal or season-mechanic pages merely because patch_id changed
host_injection_scope.authority: provider session memory caches only the filtered static capsule; SQLite and the active version tuple remain authoritative

ui_entry.label: 一键整理策略 Wiki
ui_entry.result: draft pages or questions; not silent publishing
